basic_info.description: A reimagined home on a coveted tree-lined street. This residence blends classic SF architecture w/ modern luxury. A recent down-to-studs renovation brought a new foundation, seismic upgrades, plumbing, electrical, windows & doors. Rich hardwood floors, recessed lighting, & designer finishes add warmth & elegance. A formal living rm w/ grand picture window, original fireplace, & custom built-ins flows to a dining rm w/ wainscoting & designer lighting. The sleek kitchen boasts stone counters, contemporary appliances & an ultra-deep sink w/ direct backyard access. The sun-drenched primary suite fits a king bed & sitting area, w/ a spa-like ensuite featuring a large dual vanity and designer tile. Two add'l bedrooms share a bath w/ a soaking tub. A bonus sunroom is perfect for an office/playroom. A garden-level family rm w/ direct yard access is ideal for entertaining. Includes a 3rd full bath, laundry, & 2 oversized storage rooms. The garage has a 240V EV charger. The lush backyard retreat features a large patio, low-maintenance turf, & mature bamboo for privacyperfect morning coffee or evening gatherings. Steps from shops, dining, & Muni, this stunningly updated home offers the perfect blend of historic charm & modern convenience.
